objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the Jinja2 template injection in the name parameter to run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The greeting is built by handing your input to the template engine itself, not to a template as a variable.
Look up how Jinja2 templates reach Python objects. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Identify the engine
steps.prompt: Which template engine renders the page?

steps.title: Find the parameter
steps.prompt: Which URL parameter is rendered? (parameter name)

steps.title: Name the function
steps.prompt: Which Flask function renders a string as a template? (function name)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class is this? (acronym accepted)
